notes.title: Patch Note ver 1.0.2.2 (+ Hot fix ver 1.0.2.2 a)
notes.content:
[h1]<Fixed bug list>
[*] Fixed the problem which the information UI of an employee activated by mouse over remain after mouse moving
[*] Fixed the problem which the pause filter image was abnormal

[*] Fixed the problem which appearance deactivation did not apply to right-hand E.G.O GIFT

+ The latest update translation of Japanese has been added.
[/h1]

[h1] 1. Added backer's Abnormality ON / OFF function [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/602ba707fec284b8e560d51fdfa4bf5e5cb65b8f.png[/img]

You can turn the corresponding function on or off in the Option menu of the title screen.

When deactivated, the backer's Abnormalities will not appear in the game.
The backer's Abnormalities that were deployed is replaced with one of the existing Abnormalities of the same risk level.
And the backer's Abnormality's E.G.O disappears from the E.G.O list.

If you reactivate, the backer's Abnormalities appear on the Abnormality selection screen.
Observation levels are restored and maintained. However, E.G.O that has disappeared from the list due to deactivation is not recovered.


[h1] 2. E.G.O GIFT ON / OFF and lock function added [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/42038e0ab753ce943a20b7893e14794558b1316d.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ed3d1725b85fd2d5c3246e2c63df5c54c33f29d1.png[/img]

It is possible to turn on / off the appearance of E.G.O GIFT for each slot and to disable the replacement of E.G.O GIFT.

This function is available only for deployment parts, not for management parts.


[h1] 3. Balance adjustment [/h1]
[list]
[*] Change the special work success rate of D-01-105
[*] Change the appearance date of the noon of Indigo 
[*] Increased D-02-107's suppression difficulty
[/list]

[h1] 4. Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed serial number error in D-03-109 (D-01-106 -> D-03-109)
[*] Fixed the problem which the Qliphoth counter decreasing condition of D-03-109 did not work properly.
[*] Fixed the problem which the special work of D-09-104 did not apply to some Abnormalities and Ordeals
(After the update, special tasks will not be applied to certain Abnormalities and Ordeals.)
[*] Fixed the problem which the tutorial did not work
[*] Fixed the problem which the movement of D-01-110 was abnormal
[*] Fixed the problem which employees who were attacked by D-01-110 were not seen
[*] Fixed the problem which the E.G.O created by deployment part could not be saved
[*] Fixed the problem which Panic employees did not show up as the dead employee on the results screen
[*] Fixed some weapon bugs
[*] Fixed the problem which it is impossible to clear the day when D-01-106 escaping
[*] Fixed the problem which the containment unit's color changed when D-01-105 escaped
[/list]

[h1] There is a problem that employees are attacking in the air at intervals.
If the problem occurs, the game is abnormally stressed and the game progresses slowly.

If you encounter any of the above problems, please send us the compressed folder of the path below.

save file path : %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Project_Moon
mail: support@projmoon.com[/h1]

notes.title: Secondary creation and Employee appearance change MOD guide
notes.content:
[h1]1. Secondary creation guide[/h1]

We have received a lot of additional inquiries to reinvent the detailed Guide.

We want to have the second creative outlet of Lobotomy Corporation actively.

※ The guidelines are intended to prevent people from using the 2nd generation to make unfair commercial gains.
※ For guidelines, refer to the guidelines provided in the various creations.


[h1]1. You can not use the official image resources that are the work of ProjectMoon.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Use of the official resources will cause confusion between the official creation and the secondary creation. 
[*] Do not sell Goods products that have used the official resources
[*]It is okay to create creations that use official resources for individual collection purposes.
[*] We don't mind using it on personal tweets, blogs, headers etc.
[*] LobotomyCorporation game streaming is available.
[*]Please note that the official image resource is copyrighted by ProjectMoon.
[/list]

[h1]2. Please specify the second creative item as " possible ".[/h1]
[list]
[*]It does not have to be stated. However, please make sure there is no confusion between the 2nd creations and the official creations.
[/list]

[h1]3. It is prohibited to mass produce goods for commercial purposes.[/h1]
[list]
[*]It is not the creation of a corporative private company; it must be a non-registered person team.
[*]No matter what type of journal, journal, file, notebook, or acrylic stand you have.
[*]Make sure they have no commercial purpose.
[*]Excessive business feasibility and copyright infringements will cause legal issues. 
[/list]

[h1]4. Please enjoy it as long as it doesn't cause social trouble.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Do not damage the image of the Lobotomy Corporation, or assume that it is in conflict with the prevailing winds and has exceeded social limits.

[h1]Q3.Lobotomy Corporation on the use of the Offical logo[/h1]

[h1]Q4. Is cosplay available?[/h1]

4. Yes, it is possible.


[h1]Q5. Is sound resources available?[/h1]

A5. Many of the sounds used in LobotomyCorporation are free sources and purchased music.
As a result, the sound resource is not copyrighted by ProjectMoon. If problems occur with that sound resource, the copyright holder of that resource can exercise the copyright.


[h1]Q6. The video has not been registered or it has been removed as a copyright of sound.[/h1]

A6. You'll need to edit the section that contains the music you're having problems with or contact your video site for more information.  Unfortunately, we cannot exercise the copyright in this area, so we must follow the original author's instructions.


[h1]Q7. Can I create a second production of adult content (sexual expression)[/h1]

A6. Please ensure that only adults can see the 2nd creation. We want you to create it in a way that doesn't cause too much social controversy.  


※ The guidelines do not imply all liability. 
The guidelines may change later. 
We just want to have fun creating secondary forms of art.


We always appreciate the second creation of creators who love Lobotomy Corporation and we're encouraged by them.

We would like to see the creative relationship between the 2nd creators and ProjectMoon that respect each other. 

We wish you an enjoyable second creative culture in the future.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice on Price Variation and Art Book Production
notes.content:
[h1] 1. Price change guide [/h1]

As early access is terminated and the game is officially released, the game price will be raised to $25.

[h1] 2. Artbook production [/h1]

After the official release, the artbook will be produced.

Artbooks are made in the direction that show the concept of the game, not an illustrated book that contains all the art in the game.

The artbook consists of the following.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/0792427a11d476b725c09d57f255eddb10afa6c5.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/e21ddf80ce6d25a8752b9c521e5cd6c65c497d9e.png[/img]

※ The image is an example and may be changed at the time of actual production.

[list]
[*] Production schedule: late April to early May
[*] Approximately 150 pages
[*] 50 Abnormalities 
[*] Includes in-game concept and manual 
[/list]

However, it is difficult to say for sure that mail order of artbooks will proceed.
This is because the profitability of artbook sales is unclear.

As a result of inquiring the book publisher about the production of an art book, it has been rejected because its profitability is not good.
For this reason, the artbook will be produced by our self-publishing.
In this case, there is a great deal of risk involved in the mass production and mail-order sales because the costs and revenues of sales cannot be predicted.

After the official release, it will be decided to sell artbooks in the future based on the costs incurred after producing the art book for Tumblbug Rewards.

If it is difficult to sell physical artbooks, we could proceed to sales in a digital artbook.


[h1] 3. Soundtrack [/h1]

The original soundtrack created through outsourcing will be uploaded into the game folder after the official release.
After the official release, you can check sound files in the folder of the path where the game is installed.

However, since the music files other than the original sound are purchased by purchasing sound assets, they are not uploaded into the sound folder.

After the official release, it will be decided to sell artbooks in the future based on the costs incurred after producing the art book for Tumblbug Rewards.

If it is difficult to sell physical artbooks, we could proceed to sales in a digital artbook.


[h1] 3. Soundtrack [/h1]

The original soundtrack created through outsourcing will be uploaded into the game folder after the official release.
After the official release, you can check sound files in the folder of the path where the game is installed.

However, since the music files other than the original sound are purchased by purchasing sound assets, they are not uploaded into the sound folder.

notes.title: Notice of Future Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello.

Today, we would like to tell you about future developments and updates.


[h1]1. Financial Situation[/h1]

Since players from not only Korea but also from various countries around the world bought Lobotomy Corporation, our financial situation has become much better than three months ago.

Thanks to the Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Russian translation teams, the number of new game buyers has increased.

Once again, thanks to the Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Traditional Chinese Translation Teams. 


[h1]2. Development Plan[/h1]

Lobotomy Corporation's story from the 46th to the ending will be updated at the official launch.

The official release is expected from the middle of March to the end of March.

Until the official launch, we will focus on story and content development from the 46th to the ending internally.
At the same time, we will optimize the game, make a tutorial, support the steam cloud system, improve convenience, and adjust balance.
Tutorials, convenience enhancements, and balance adjustments will be updated as soon as they are fully developed before release.
(We are planning to take a break during the Lunar New Year holidays.)

On the other hand, in the case of a Steam workshop that gives a lot of inquiries, there is no formal support plan.

The biggest reason is the technical problem.

In the case of a MOD tool that allows players to create own Abnormality, it should have been considered from the initial design of the game.

If we are going to create a game that utilizes the Steam workshop in future, we will try to proceed the game design using Steam workshop from the initial stage.


[h1]3. After official release of Lobotomy Corporation[/h1]

[list]
[*] Sound Track Sales
[*] Additional Abnormality charged DLC
[*] Successor development
[/list]

Due to the much improved financial situation, Project Moon has been able to maintain.
After the official release, bug fixes and maintenance of Lobotomy Corporation will proceed.

After that, we will develop and sell soundtracks and additional Abnormality DLCs.

In the case of an Abnormality DLC, it will be Abnormalities made with the ideas of Tumblbug supporters.
After that, considering the situation of the game and the reaction of the DLC, we will decide whether to develop and sell the additional contents DLC (Abnormality, Ordeals, challenge mode).


[h1] 4. Successor [/h1]

The platform and genre have not yet been defined for new works.

We take into account all platform possibilities, including PCs, mobile, and consoles.
Genres also have many possibilities. Simulations, actions, and platforms have yet to be decided.

What we can say for sure is that we will be covering the story after Lobotomy Corporation and what is happening in the world.

Project Moon's goal is to create games and contents that will have the unstopped stories of the world around Lobotomy Corporation and characters and keep providing interesting experiences.

However, in the case of DLC and sequel development, the number of manpower is lower than the existing number, so the existing speed may not come out.
For the stable operation of Project Moon, some of the existing team members left the team after the official launch.
(They did not leave the team through a dispute.)

Lobotomy Corporation was the first experience to create the proper game for everyone on Project Moon.

So there were a lot of inexperiences from design to maintenance, which made it impossible to create the ideal work we thought.

Nevertheless, we are always thankful to the players who enjoyed Lobotomy Corporation.

In the next work, we will try to make better game through design, skill and visual lessons learned from Lobotomy Corporation.

Thank you.


[h1] <Notice of difficulty survey> [/h1]

Lobotomy Corporation's Difficulty Survey is in progress.
we would appreciate it if you would like to take the survey while considering the difficulty you felt while playing the game.

You can conduct the survey from the link below.

[h1][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScxSbDXAGsQ-xnvALJmSVhLYZD5p07wZNcyDQ7e3PfO2kedfg/viewform?usp=sf_link] <Go to survey> [/url][/h1]

notes.title: Notice of delaying updates and adding new systems
notes.content:
[h1] 1. Defer Update [/h1]

The update of the Plague doctor and new Abnormalities that was originally scheduled for January 27 will be postponed to February 3 due to delayed work due to influenza infection of the director.

Instead, on January 27, the existing game will be reorganized and modified, and new systems will be added.


[h1] 2. New system addition[/h1]

[list]
[*] [h1] Department functions [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/3ac98dd788372e070118d78d2f50b46fc304c147.png[/img]

After the update, 2 department functions will add.

[list]
[*] [b] Survival effect of office worker [/b]

All employees get a special effect from the survival rate of the office worker.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/1e47725afc794cb564ab37efcbd7e90cdf179d9f.png[/img]

The type of effect varies from department to department, depending on the degree of opening of the department.
There are three levels of effects, and the higher the level, the better the effect.
The level of the survival effect can be confirmed in each division-specific Regenerating UI.

If office workers die or fall into a panic and the survival rate decreases during the game, the level of effectiveness decreases. When the office worker survival rate reaches zero, the effect that was applied disappears.

[*] [b] Continuous service effect [/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/c8a1db5712c01bf0deb783454e005d48fe0d1bce.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/a370f1d86631027b3eebf9ce4ac358d1c06f2abe.png[/img]

Depending on how long an employee has been placed in a department, that employee has a special effect.

The Continuous service effect is different for each department, and the effect gives the title and armband.

However, if an employee who has obtained the service effect of one department is placed in another department, the service effect is reset.

Employees who have worked for more than 10 days in one department for the longest period of time will become excellent employees in that department and will receive additional benefits and a special armband.
[/list]

[*] [h1] employee - office worker interlock system [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ab2b9e398873d67148de993f155f569205344e9f.png[/img]

If the time limit is exceeded after all the employees of a department have left the department since the update, a system will be added where all the office worker in that department will panic. Also, if all employees die, all office workers will also commit suicide, and all workers in the department will die.

[strike]A department that all office worker is dead has a lower work success rate.[/strike]

[u]A department that all employee is dead has a lower work success rate.[/u]

[*] [h1] Panic changes and diversification [/h1]

[list]
[*] [b] Panic Changes [/b]

The panic employees will no longer receive the SP(MP) Recovery Bullet.
The panic employees will no longer receive mental restoration from tool-type Abnormalities.

[*] [b] Panic diversification [/b]

The employee's panic type depends on the highest value.
Fortitude - murder
Prudence - Suicide
Temperance - wandering
Justice -containment unit opening
[/list]


[/list]

[h1]2. System Additions and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*][h1] 1. Energy acquisition at end of Ordeal [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/fadabc1c435ca8fc81cbbf418b9a7a73f78c9369.png[/img]

After the update, the energy is obtained When Ordeal is suppressed.
The more you end a high-level Ordeal, the more energy you can obtain.


[h1] 2. Bullet system changes[/h1] 

The default number of bullets will change to the number of Qliphoth meltdown gauges for that day.
The existing reloading system disappears, and every time a Qliphoth meltdown occurs, it is changed to a full reload with the default number of bullets.
Attributes Increase the duration of the protective shield. However, when entering the containment room, the shield will be released.


[*][h1]3. Add Qliphoth overload system[/h1]

[b] This is a new system that applies to Abnormalities over WAW level [/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/59e4b8590108aeaf217700e52873434c8ad935fa.png[/img]

[h1]Each time you work on a Abnormality, the success rate of that Abnormality will decrease when you complete the work.[/h1]

However, depending on the level of the risk(WAW, ALEPH), the decreased success rate differs. 
The higher risk level, the higher the decreased success rate.
A cumulative operation also applies a reduced success rate to the containment room where the Qliphoth meltdown is triggered.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/db3e5ab4e7ae060981107364a29c89ef9ca0156d.png[/img]

[h1] The Qliphoth overload is initialized when the Qliphoth meltdown occurs. [/h1]
When Qliphoth meltdown occurs, all of the successes that were accumulated before will be reset, and you can start working again with the default success rate.

[/list]

notes.title: 12/9 Notice about changes to additional systems
notes.content:
[h1] 1. Energy acquisition at end of Ordeal [/h1]

After the update, the energy is obtained When Ordeal is suppressed.
The more you end a high-level Ordeal, the more energy you can obtain.


[h1] 2. Bullet system changes[/h1] 

The default number of bullets will change to the number of Qliphoth meltdown gauges for that day.
The existing reloading system disappears, and every time a Qliphoth meltdown occurs, it is changed to a full reload with the default number of bullets.
Attributes Increase the duration of the protective shield. However, when entering the containment room, the shield will be released.


[h1] 3. Changes in Qliphoth overload system[/h1] 

The  Qliphoth overload system is a system in which the success rate of work decreases as the work accumulates in one Abnormality.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/568220/announcements/detail/1466349450185830271] <Go to previous notice >[/url]

The Qliphoth overload is changed to apply only to Abnormality of WAW, ALEPH, and so on.
Each time a Qliphoth meltdown occurs, the Qliphoth overload is reset.


[h1] 4. Manual addition[/h1] 

In the fourth week of December, a manual will be added to inform player needed for gameplay.


This patch is a system added to prevent the standardized play from appearing as the game progresses. With this patch, we wanted to create a gameplay that kept the tension going despite the game progresses.

It is not a purpose to make an entry barrier for new users due to increased difficulty. If the initial difficulty increases excessively after this patch, we will try to mitigate it through a continuous patch.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice about IMPORTANT System Changes and Additional Systems
notes.content:
[h1] 1. Energy acquisition at end of Ordeal [/h1]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/fadabc1c435ca8fc81cbbf418b9a7a73f78c9369.png[/img]

After the update, the energy is obtained When Ordeal is suppressed.
The more you end a high-level Ordeal, the more energy you can obtain.

<Example>
Obtain 10% of the energy to be collected when end of the dawn
Obtain 15% of the energy to be collected when end of the noon
Obtain 20% of the energy to be collected when end of the dusk
Obtain 25% of the energy to be collected when end of the midnight
(values may vary.)


[h1] 2. Change bullet reload cycle [/h1]

The system changes so that the bullets only reload when the Qliphoth meltdown.
The existing bullets were loaded one at a time after each use.
After the update, the existing reloading system disappears, and every time a Qliphoth meltdown occurs, bullets are a full reload with the default number of bullets.

[h1] 3. Add a Qliphoth overload system [/h1]

[b] This is a new system that applies to Abnormalities over HE level [/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/59e4b8590108aeaf217700e52873434c8ad935fa.png[/img]

[h1]Each time you work on a Abnormality, the success rate of that Abnormality will decrease when you complete the work.[/h1]

However, depending on the level of the risk(HE, WAW, ALEPH), the decreased success rate differs. 
The higher risk level, the higher the decreased success rate.
A cumulative operation also applies a reduced success rate to the containment room where the Qliphoth meltdown is triggered.

<Example>
Completion of Aleph level Abnormality 1 times, success rate is decreased 0%
Completion of Aleph level Abnormality 2 times, success rate is decreased 5%
Completion of Aleph level Abnormality 3 times, success rate is decreased 10%
(Figures may vary.)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/db3e5ab4e7ae060981107364a29c89ef9ca0156d.png[/img]

[h1] The Qliphoth overload is initialized when the Ordeals appear. [/h1]
When an Ordeal comes up, all of the successes that were accumulated before will be reset, and you can start working again with the default success rate.

notes.title: About Project Moon sponsorship and future direction
notes.content:
Thank you very much for emails and articles you wrote.

First of all, We think we should let you know about donating.


1. Crowd funding

Crowdfunding, like Tumblbug and Kickstarter, will not open anymore.

The biggest reason is that even the first crowdfunding that we have been doing is not properly rewarding our sponsors. Therefore, it is not suitable to carry out second crowdfunding with light mind without responsibility. We will concentrate on development itself, as crowdfunding and follow-up preparation also take a considerable amount of time.


2.Goods sale

It is also difficult to raise sales by selling goods.

The planning and production costs of the goods and the shipping cost are also consuming a lot of time, and it seems to be a realistic difficulty to go ahead with the sales of the goods. In addition, the short-term planned and produced goods are expected to be low-quality goods that we are sorry to sell.


3. Direct sponsorship through account

Since we are currently operating a corporation in the form of a corporation, receiving individual sponsorship through an account is difficult to proceed due to various legal and tax issues.


4. Digital content sales

Perhaps the choice we can make about sponsoring is probably the only option for how we sell digital download content such as wallpapers, not games, through PayPal. And the wallpapers are priced at least 20$, and it seems to be a format to sell at a price higher than the quality.

But this is really the last thing we want to choose.


Whatever the personnel, form and start of the team, we are no longer a student, but a game development start-up company in the form of a profit-making corporation. That's why we want to get the best out of the game. Even if the funds that can be held for a while through fans' minds are collected, if the game can not make profit, it will be the situation like now.

Perhaps the solution we are looking for is to promote game sales or to invest in other outside companies or investors.

We also want to keep the team and company somehow and keep this world by creating multiple games continuously. But if the method is a bust, it will collapse again someday.

This is a challenge that must be overcome if we continue to develop and maintain this team and company.


So, first of all, Project Moon will try to keep up with fun game and world with the power of its own.

We sincerely appreciate for mail of cheer from all over the world.

We hope you enjoy Lobotomy Corporation just like now.

If possible, We hope that someday we will be able to grow and meet again with a new game of a different form.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Updated] Notice about Checkpoint system change
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/6e4180e113dfaa397934560f801ceeb853aef59f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/622d4e520570d8bc728709d1b30fcaa9251b4dd4.png[/img]

[h1]This update adds the ability to save the most recent day.[/h1]

On older systems, save was only performed on a 5-day basis.
So if you restarted the game, So if you start the game again, you could only start from the previous 5-day checkpoint (ex: day1, day6, day11 ...).

[h1]After the update, if you start the game again, you will start with the setting part of the last day (Exclude Challenge Mode) (B).

The 'DAY RETRY' button has been added to the ESC menu to allow the management part to restart its DAY (Exclude Challenge Mode) (B)

However, if you re-enter DAY, the progress of the day, such as encyclopedia, PE box, E.G.O equipment, etc., will not be saved.

After DAY clear, you can choose whether to skip to the next day in the result screen (C) or to retry DAY (Exclude Challenge Mode) (B).

If you select move to the next day (C), the last day will be updated to the next day. [/h1]

'Return to checkpoints' will remain that move to the previous checkpoint(A) with retaining the encyclopedia, PE box, and E.G.O equipment.

If you select Continue when the game ends during the management part, you can start from the placement part of the day you ended (B)


[h1]<encyclopedia, Equipment save Presence>

encyclopedia, EGO saved

-A, C

Book, EGO not saved

-B[/h1]

notes.title: Notice about change of supporting Operating system for crash resolution (32bit-> 64bit)
notes.content:
As our games are updated, Abnormality resources, story BGM, and story CG have increased.

As these resources increase, memory usage increases,
As a result, excessive memory usage causes frequent crashes (It occurs particularly frequently in the middle layer and above.)

Lobotomy Corporation is currently built with 32-bit applications and cannot use these resources seamlessly.

There are ways to reduce resource usage, due to current development conditions, it is difficult to reduce resource usage in order to add content and increase quality in the future.


[h1]Therefore, we plan to use 64-bit builds to make Lobotomy Corporation run more smoothly.

The current 32-bit version is available from the Steam Library, which should be changed from Lobotomy Corporation-Property-Beta-lobotomy_32bit.

Precautions
- Please note that the latest builds are not available for 32-bit and below operating systems.

- There is no change in the save file. If you change to the beta version, you can use it as the same save file.
[/h1]


<How to join the BETA version>
1. Right click on Steam Library's Lobotomy Corporation and click on Game Properties

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/0a9749a8d7ccc5ce9e55b8083215507ffa313fca.png[/img]

2. Beta tab click on game properties

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/5fa5ac7975404aadec271c0f142d2e582d74754e.png[/img]

3. Select 'lobotomy_32bit' and click Close

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/18d0bf7b7d67f671a691135705436adec59219d3.png[/img]

So if you restarted the game, So if you start the game again, you could only start from the previous 5-day checkpoint (ex: day1, day6, day11 ...).

[h1]After the update, if you start the game again, you will start with the setting part of the last day(B).

The 'DAY RETRY' button has been added to the ESC menu to allow the management part to restart its DAY (B)

However, if you re-enter DAY, the progress of the day, such as encyclopedia, PE box, E.G.O equipment, etc., will not be saved.

After DAY clear, you can choose whether to skip to the next day in the result screen (C) or to retry DAY(B).

If you select move to the next day (C), the last day will be updated to the next day. [/h1]

'Return to checkpoints' will remain that move to the previous checkpoint(A) with retaining the encyclopedia, PE box, and E.G.O equipment.

If you select Continue when the game ends during the management part, you can start from the placement part of the day you ended (B)


[h1]<encyclopedia, Equipment save Presence>

encyclopedia, EGO saved

-A, C

Book, EGO not saved

-B[/h1]

[h1]2. Tool-type Abnormality[/h1]
This update adds a new type of Abnormality, the "Tool-type Abnormality".
Unlike conventional Abnormalities, tool-type Abnormality is Abnormality that emphasizes 'how to use' rather than 'how to manage'.

On the fourth day (Day4, Day9, Day14 ....), a list of tool-type Abnormality appears on the anniversary selection screen, and you can select one of them.

There are three types of tool-type Abnormality: single-use, mounting, and continuous use.
The method of using the tool-type Abnormality is as follows.

[olist]
[*]Click the containment room to use.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/8466f91e6191fc9bde84ce27559b3477435b855f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/d5d6407a4289f5ab27141e7e9dace3bc8ac4aaba.png[/img]

[/olist]

Tool-type Abnormalities are updated automatically according to the number of uses and usage time.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/c392807b99e0c3a690f8339bf9be410dd5c48769.png[/img]

The three departments of Briah and the sephira in charge were added.
Also added a story of Briah's sephira.
(Added to the Geburah episode 3, the Chesed episode 4, and the Tiphereth episode 4)

The main story was added until Day 35.



[h1]4. New Department of Research Function - Bullet Research [/h1]

The research function of the middle departments adds bullet research.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/5b0e135ce48f9a34899a93713e5a9da120e3824d.png[/img]

You can use a bullet to give a specific effect to the target you want.
You can use any kind of bullet in the presence of a bullet.

You can use a limited number of bullets, and each time you use a bullet, the number of bullets decreases.
After using the bullet, the bullet charging gauge will fill, and when the charging gauge is filled to the end, the new bullet will be charged.

The types of bullets that will be available through this update are listed below.
Future bullet performance enhancements will also be added to the research.

<Types of bullets>
[list]
[*]Restore employee's Health and Mentality

[*]R, W, B, P shield
Shields take the damage that an employee receives instead.
The shield lasts for a certain amount of time, and the employee is not attacked by that attribute while there is a shield.
However, if you take damage beyond the shield's HP, the shield may be destroyed.

[*]Reduced movement speed
Reduces the speed of movement of the target during a certain amount of time.
However, it does not affect the speed of the target's attack.

[*]Employee Disposition
You can immediately dispose of employees who are affected by panic or Abnormality.
[/list]


[h1] 5. Game system addition and some changes [/h1]

[olist]
[*] [h1]Change to recovery system[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/837a9807c7619208bdffdcafc48705e6b2c2e56a.png[/img]

At the top of the main department, a recovery gauge UI is added to indicate the recovery period.
The recovery gauge rises over time, and when the recovery gauge is filled to the end, the health and mentality of the employees inside the main department are restored.

However, if the Abnormality enters the main department, the gauge will stop working and the recovery will not proceed.

It also changes the way the recovery system recovers from the ratio of total health and mentality to the way the fixed values are restored.

[*][h1] Limit number of Abnormality works deleted[/h1]

The limit on the number of works that exist for each department and each containment room will disappear.


[*] [h1]Added Qliphoth meltdown system[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/7b51508ea4fd816082fcd917ff1a2eff25c623eb.png[/img]

Depending on the number of works, the Qliphoth meltdown alarm gauge rises gradually.
When the alarm gauge reaches the end, a reported meltdown occurs throughout the facility.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ea4c4d94bf6834c81f9332f2b04ac662e195a516.png[/img]

A warning timer is generated in the containment room where Qliphoth meltdown is triggered, and the warning timer gradually decreases over time.
When the warning timer reaches 0, the Qliphoth counter of the annunciator in the corresponding containment room becomes 0, and the E-BOX decreases by the negative E-BOX of the containment room.

The Qliphoth meltdown will be released as soon as the employee enters the containment room by ordering the operation in the containment room where the meltdown occurred. In addition, the Qliphoth meltdown alarm gauge does not rise with this operation.

Qliphoth meltdown can go up to a maximum of 10 levels starting from level 1.
The level rises whenever the Qliphoth meltdown is activated.
As the level rises, the number of containment rooms in which meltdown occurs increases.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ca49642c06ab6102589a5a44444498248f5a266b.png[/img]

The way the Ordeals take place is combined with the Qliphoth meltdown system through this update. At a certain level of meltdown, Ordeals appear instead of Qliphoth meltdown. As the level rises, a higher level of Ordeals emerge.

[*] [h1]Remove LOB Reward rank over time[/h1]

The way in which LOB compensation was paid differently according to the time of clearing the stage disappears.

After this update, the same LOB compensation will be paid regardless of the clear time when clearing the stage.

However, the player who has died or panicked employees, more escaped Abnormalities will get the LOB point penalty.

The more you can not manage your facility properly, the less you will get LOB compensation.

[*][h1] Change mechanism of pale attribute [/h1]

The pale attribute's attack method is changed in such a way that the damage is reduced in proportion to its total HP.

[*] [h1] Reflects the opening of the department to the sepia story [/h1]

Previously, regardless of the department's opening, the Sephirah's story was conducted according to the completion of the mission.

After the update, the department must be opened to the next level so that the story and mission will be changed.

[*][h1]Added Briefing function of Sepira [/h1]

Depending on the status of the department, the function of each department's briefing will be added.

[h1]4. New Department of Research Function - Bullet Research [/h1]

The research function of the middle departments adds bullet research.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/5b0e135ce48f9a34899a93713e5a9da120e3824d.png[/img]

You can use a bullet to give a specific effect to the target you want.
You can use any kind of bullet in the presence of a bullet.

You can use a limited number of bullets, and each time you use a bullet, the number of bullets decreases.
After using the bullet, the bullet charging gauge will fill, and when the charging gauge is filled to the end, the new bullet will be charged.

The types of bullets that will be available through this update are listed below.
Future bullet performance enhancements will also be added to the research.

<Types of bullets>
[list]
[*]Restore employee's Health and Mentality

[*]R, W, B, P shield
Shields take the damage that an employee receives instead.
The shield lasts for a certain amount of time, and the employee is not attacked by that attribute while there is a shield.
However, if you take damage beyond the shield's HP, the shield may be destroyed.

[*]Reduced movement speed
Reduces the speed of movement of the target during a certain amount of time.
However, it does not affect the speed of the target's attack.

[*]Employee Disposition
You can immediately dispose of employees who are affected by panic or Abnormality.
[/list]


[h1] 5. Game system addition and some changes [/h1]

[olist]
[*] [h1]Change to recovery system[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/837a9807c7619208bdffdcafc48705e6b2c2e56a.png[/img]

At the top of the main department, a recovery gauge UI is added to indicate the recovery period.
The recovery gauge rises over time, and when the recovery gauge is filled to the end, the health and mentality of the employees inside the main department are restored.

However, if the Abnormality enters the main department, the gauge will stop working and the recovery will not proceed.

It also changes the way the recovery system recovers from the ratio of total health and mentality to the way the fixed values are restored.

[*][h1] Limit number of Abnormality works deleted[/h1]

The limit on the number of works that exist for each department and each containment room will disappear.


[*] [h1]Added Qliphoth meltdown system[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/7b51508ea4fd816082fcd917ff1a2eff25c623eb.png[/img]

Depending on the number of works, the Qliphoth meltdown alarm gauge rises gradually.
When the alarm gauge reaches the end, a reported meltdown occurs throughout the facility.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ea4c4d94bf6834c81f9332f2b04ac662e195a516.png[/img]

A warning timer is generated in the containment room where Qliphoth meltdown is triggered, and the warning timer gradually decreases over time.
When the warning timer reaches 0, the Qliphoth counter of the annunciator in the corresponding containment room becomes 0, and the E-BOX decreases by the negative E-BOX of the containment room.

The Qliphoth meltdown will be released as soon as the employee enters the containment room by ordering the operation in the containment room where the meltdown occurred. In addition, the Qliphoth meltdown alarm gauge does not rise with this operation.

Qliphoth meltdown can go up to a maximum of 10 levels starting from level 1.
The level rises whenever the Qliphoth meltdown is activated.
As the level rises, the number of containment rooms in which meltdown occurs increases.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ca49642c06ab6102589a5a44444498248f5a266b.png[/img]

The way the Ordeals take place is combined with the Qliphoth meltdown system through this update. At a certain level of meltdown, Ordeals appear instead of Qliphoth meltdown. As the level rises, a higher level of Ordeals emerge.

[*] [h1]Remove LOB Reward rank over time[/h1]

The way in which LOB compensation was paid differently according to the time of clearing the stage disappears.

After this update, the same LOB compensation will be paid regardless of the clear time when clearing the stage.

However, the player who has died or panicked employees, more escaped Abnormalities will get the LOB point penalty.

The more you can not manage your facility properly, the less you will get LOB compensation.

After the update, the department must be opened to the next level so that the story and mission will be changed.

notes.title: Notice of October update contents, language translation and TGS
notes.content:
[h1]1. Large-scale update scheduled for late October[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more than 10 new Abnormalities
[*]Add tool Abnormality
[*]Add three central departments(Briah)
[*]Main Story Add up to Day 35
[*]Add a new department research
[/list]

[h1]2. Notice about language XML modification[/h1]
The English version is being translated into English by professional translation companies.

However, for languages other than English, there is a financial difficulty in translating at the early access stage.

There is a real difficulty in supporting the official translation of other languages, but we decided to make it public so that you can modify all of the language files used in the game.

We apologize for the inability to support translations in multiple languages.

You can edit the language file by referring to the guide below.

[h1]<Language xml modification guide>[/h1]

[b]1. Change text[/b]

You can change the text inside the game by modifying the XML files in the path below.

[h1]LobotomyCorp\LobotomyCorp_Data\ExternalData\xml\Language[/h1]
[list]
[*]AgentName.xml: Name information of an employee.
[*](lang)\AgentLyrics_(lang).xml: An employee's script.
[*](lang)\AngelaDesc_(lang).xml: Angela's script in the management part.
[*](lang)\Skills_(lang).xml: The name of the work
[*](lang)\creature\ *. XML: Text used for Abnormality.
[*]Localize \ (lang) \ Story \ *. XML: Story text.
[*]Other XML is the text used for the UI.
[/list]
[h1]※ Precautions
[list]
[*]Korean comments in XML are used during development. Therefore, there is no relation to the current XML structure.
[*]There is dummy text that is not used in the actual game.
[*]If you change any data other than text, the game may not work.
[/list][/h1]

[b]2. Changing the font[/b]

You can change the font in the Font.xml file in the path below.

[h1]LobotomyCorp\LobotomyCorp_Data\ExternalData\xml\Font.xml[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/b5cf3ae692fea3a24da432076911bc2bcab6ed5f.png[/img]

There are four fonts for each language, and you can change the font by entering the font name.

If the value is empty, use the default font of Lobotomy.

The names of the fonts that can be input can be confirmed by clicking on the upper right corner of the title screen.

Supported fonts may vary depending on the language.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/26ba185baeaa518c727b7b206c74ed34648971eb.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/c63f87e86e36945d0f5baff7379730271c941889.png[/img]



[h1]3. TGS Exhibition Information[/h1]

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1] 1. Instructions for saving errors [/h1]

We are constantly looking for the cause of save-related errors.

[h1]If you are having trouble saving and loading, please compress the Project_Moon folder in the following path and send it by e-mail.

Mail: lobotomycorp@gmail.com

save file path : %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Project_Moon[/h1]

We will try to fix the issue as soon as possible.
We apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced.


[h1] 2. Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*]‘Nameless Fetus’ equipment did not show up
[*]Management method of 'Snow Queen' did not come out properly
[*]'Do not Touch Me' serial number has a risk level
[*]Remove some filters in the 'Do Not Touch Me' filter
[*]'Nothing there' did not appear in the game
[*]‘Silent Orchestra's movement does not appear
[*]Employee did not die after the special ability of 'Crumbling Armor' was activated.
[*]The special ability condition of 'Crumbling Armor' did not work properly
[*]The special ability of 'Red Shoes' was not solved by clicking
[*]Problem that did not move to other Abnormalities after working on 'Laetitia'
[*]Correction of equipment-related numerical values
[*]The employee wielded a weapon when commanded to suppress
[*]Problem that Lob point saved below 0
[*]The employee information ui could not verify in the work order ui.
[*]The problem that suppression ui did not open when panic employee clicked
[*]The Abnormality selection screen did not come out normally according to the day
[*]Improved mouse command responsiveness
[*]The problem that the Ordeals were ended even if one died in the Ordeal
[*]Ordeal UI color change
[*]Change ui color of selected employee
[/list]

[h1] 3. Changes [/h1]

notes.title: Patch Note ver 0.1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Save data has been initialized[/u] due to change of management method and system. We will keep the save file as much as possible and change it.[/b][/h1]


[h1] 1. Abnoramlity and ordeal added [/h1]
   [list]
    [*] Added 7 existing Abnoramlity
    [*] Added a new ordeal
[/list]

[h1] 2. Employee appearance changed[/h1]

[h1] 3. Inventory UI Reorganization [/h1]

[h1]4. Important Changes[/h1]

[h1][Employee Level Up through Lob points][/h1]

 You can raise your employee's status level through LOB points earned daily. You can also change your name and appearance by paying 1Lob  Point for your first hire.


[h1][LoB Point Reward according to Clear Time][/h1]

 For each day, the appropriate clear time and corresponding clear compensation are given at the Lob Point. Employees can be raised through LOB points, so in order to raise the level of employees, it is designed to be more efficient to clear quickly than constant farming.

[h1][Changing the condition of the number of Abnormality care][/h1]

Player had to manage the Abnormality of all departments, but now the number of Abnormality management is dependent only on the department. It's easy to manage only safe Abnormality but the player needs to manage dangerous, energy-intensive Abnormality in order to minimize quick clearances and ordeals.


[h1][Clear even if an escape object exists][/h1]

 Even if there is an escape object, it is possible to clear the day,  but a penalty will be charged according to the risk level of each escape object.

  [list][*]ZAYIN = penalty X
   [*]TETH = -1 Lob
   [*]HE = -3 Lob
   [*]WAW = -5 Lob
  [*] ALEPH = Reset compensation[/list]

You can choose whether to take the penalty and clear the Day or to receive the clear rewards after the suppression.

[h1][Fixed opening order of management method][/h1]

 The management of the Abnormality is now open in order. We wanted to increase the weight of management method by placing important and demanding information behind.


[h1][Condition of ordeal][/h1]

 Now the ordeals are triggered according to the total number of operations, not the absolute time. The number of times that each ordeal is triggered varies for each day. In the beginning, if the ordeal is activated, it will be difficult to prevent, but if you install the appropriate E.G.O according to the progress, we will clear it easily.

As before, the ordeal will be added with ratings of Dawn, Noon, Thunder,  and Midnight.

[h1][Splash Attack Changed][/h1]

  A lot of splash weapons were able to attack agent. As a result, it became difficult to use splash attack weapons, so instead of lowering the attack power of splash, we changed the identification of the peers.


[h1][Employee Title][/h1]

 Each employee is assigned a character and title whenever the level is increased. The character and title are given differently depending on which stat is higher at the time of upgrade, and the stat increase effect is applied differently for each title.


[h1]5. Bug Fix and Balance Fix[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Worker Bee's UI was displayed wrong
    [*] Manage level UI not showing 4th grade correctly
    [*] Edit Assign Parts UI
    [*] Modify system log dialog
    [*] UI error in suppressing officer
    [*] Change range of weapons
    [*] Adjust some weapon balance
    [*] LOB given in day clear
    [*] Abnormality management method
    [*]Fixed a problem where queen bee spores continued until the next day
[/list]

notes.title: Lobotomy Corporation 0.1 Version Update Notice
notes.content:
[h1][b]With this update, we have rearranged the system of all games including employees, Abnormality, and so on.
We have created and applied several animation managements by changing not only the system but also the graphic of the employee.
Because it is a big update, we would like to explain to the players the reason for each change.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/a9d78df41e29120aba5319948debf29bd190494b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/9c776314c94912622e725af0809cdbfb6479d2f3.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/a9d78df41e29120aba5319948debf29bd190494b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/85ebac9c88e94322dc7a3262a564cb3410cb3327.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/98446e9989cc348d3a36fe0d2ecac09b695eb596.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/12d25420358261e1a08d6639ea2d0f9d96fa01c5.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/c7c652dda85910626c4d7fc776267962e3f27846.png[/img]

[h1][b]1. System Reorganization[/b][/h1]

[h1]- Delete the time limit-[/h1]

Previously, Abnormality management was time-limited. Therefore, when the player's hand was slow, they could not cope and reached a difficult situation.

Eventually, the player had to kick in time, and the game we wanted to show did not come out.

Now the system of time is eliminated from the Abnormality management system It has been modified to increase the energy according to the result of one operation in the mechanism where energy increases and decreases with time. In other words, the concept of the mood of Abnormalities changed in real-time disappears, and the atmosphere of the Abnormalities determined by the reaction of the result of one operation.

With this change, the situation in which many Abnormalities escape at once will decrease. However, as a result, the tempo of the game may be loosened, so that later ordeal will consist of militant elements that appear step by step like the older Abnormalities.

[h1]- Suppression and Combat Enhancement-[/h1]

The suppression of the previous Abnormality was simple. It was simply to suppress the Abnormality with a powerful weapon. We wanted the experience of Abnormalities to escape and subdue it to be as much a fun experience as Abnormality management. So we created attributes for every attack, so we changed the control so that there is a proper suppression method for each Abnormality as well as management rule.

There are four attack attributes in total, and Abnormalities have attack and defense attributes. It will also apply to future ordeals

Employees will also have attack and defense attributes. In this process, employees will wear equipment based on the properties of weapons and armor extracted from the Abnormality. By deploying staff with the right equipment, you can be more strategic.

[h1]- Employee stats restructuring-[/h1]

We have integrated the values, gender, characteristics, and status of employees into one. The gender and values were used only as a condition of management of particular Abnormalities, and the function was insignificant. We have worked on simplifying and integrating the existing employees' physical strength, mental strength, work speed, work efficiency and evasion rate. Values, gender, characteristics and current stat systems are now gone. Instead, everything is expressed through four values: courage / wisdom / moderation / justice.

Container - Hp / Wisdom - Mp / Moderation - Work Speed, Work Success Rate / Justice - Attack Speed, Movement Speed

Each value rises from 1 to 5 level, which increases automatically when stats such as physical strength, mental power, etc., are in charge of each value.

Also, depending on the gender and the values of the employees, the systems in which the particular powers of the Abnormalities activated also modified. For example, the rule of "death of an optimist worker works" will be changed to "Death if an employee works under a courage level 2".
The accessories that originally obtained as traits have been made available through the equipment obtained from the Abnormality. 


[h1]- Change of working system -[/h1]

Employees randomly assigned to three management works during the initial hiring process. In the past, not only the management work but also gender, values, and characteristics have all acquired randomly, and many elements have been in operation. Now it's not about how to gain an employee, but how to grow it.

Four management works now replace five essential manage works and one individual work. That is, unique works disappear, and there are only four primary management works.

Employees can use four management works from the beginning. Instead, management tasks also have a rating, and to use higher-level management works, you need to raise the rating of the tasks associated with that management work.

1~5 Level Instinct work - Courage

1 ~ 5 Level Insight work - Wisdom

1~5 Level Attachment work - Moderation

1~5 Level Repression work  - Justice

Whenever an employee performs a management work, the statistic of the value corresponding to that management work increases. If you continue to perform 'instinctive work,' HP will increase, and if a certain amount of HP increases, you will be able to have the next level of 'instinct work.'
We intended to foster employees more strategically through the changed system.

There is also a change in the way we work and how we collect energy. It divides success and failure per "tick" of management operations as before. If successful, a 'PE Box' accumulates, and an 'NE Box' gathers if it fails. The energy calculated as the sum of the success boxes (PE boxes).

However, when an employee is killed or panicked and stopped working, energy does not increase.

For example, if the number of boxes needed to complete an Abnormality ‘A’ work is 20, and you have collected seven successful blocks / 13 failed blocks at the end of the work, you will get seven energy.

Every time abandoned block accumulated; the employee is damaged. Damage received by the Abnormalities of the attack attributes and damage.
To collect a lot of success boxes, you have to proceed with the favorites work of the Abnormality, raising the employee's job success rate, and proceeding with the observation to increase the success rate of the Abnormality work. It can also increase the success rate through equipment.

[h1]- Change of observation system -[/h1]

In the existing observation system, the observation button automatically activated when the work performed a certain number of times. Observation is over by sending an employee by pressing the activated button and seeing the results. Existing observing behaviors only functioned as conceptual roles and did not give the impression of realizing the existence of the unknown.

But there was not enough time to create a real-time observation system where the player would guess or experience the details of the Abnormality.

So, as a compromise, we have changed observation system by how much energy we have acquired from the Abnormality. The energy extracted from the Abnormality works as a resource that allows observation. Observations will provide a sustainable effect that will help you manage your work, and you will be able to create Abnormality-specific equipment.

The encyclopedia will replace the observation buttons. At first, all information locked in the book. You can open the area of the drawing through the acquired success block, and the level of observation increases according to the degree of opening, and finally all information is obtained.

[h1]- Abnormality equipment -[/h1]

The player will be able to build the equipment of the Abnormality depending on the level of the Abnormality observation. The cost of production is the number of success blocks of the corresponding Abnormality. You can build equipment and wear it to your employee by consuming the "success block" of each Abnormality. If an employee wearing the equipment dies during management, the equipment automatically destroyed and the player must again build the equipment by consuming the success blocks. The number of equipment is limited.

The Abnormality equipment system allows players to equip their employees with equipment strategically and do not want to ignore Abnormalities with difficult management rules.

[h1]- Fear damage and Employee level -[/h1]

Fear damage means mental damage when an employee first encounters an Abnormality. It had applied to the past, but it is hard to know clearly how much damage it was receiving. Also, the employee's level was not significant except for the stats rise.
The changing level of employees is closely related to fear damage. Employee’s level is a measure of how well experienced and seasoned employees are. In other words, less experienced low-level employees suffer great horror damage when faced with dangerous Abnormalities, and high-level veteran employees are not disturbed by WAW Abnormality.

Employee level determined by the sum of the employees' courage/wisdom / moderation/justice values. When an employee performs a managed work, the stats will increase, which will enhance the value of the stats. Repeating this will increase the employee's level.

[h1]- Change the system to finish the day - [/h1]
Originally, we had to collect the amount of energy allocated per day and wait for the purification for 10 seconds. At the end of purification, it is possible to finish the day immediately, and if the energy decreases during the purification, it canceled. It was intended for the tension that must endure until the purification finished. But the system that changed this time was freed much in time, so we deleted the purification system. Instead, the condition for clearing the Day is that there will be no escaped Abnormality.
It had changed so that all escaped Abnormality and threats are removed on that day, and can only move on to the next day.

We wanted to take proper strategic action as time had created and employees had strengthened. Even if it is corrected later, if the Abnormality escapes and moves on to the next day, it will be done in the direction of giving a penalty.

Another change is that the day is done at the user's option. In the past, when all energy refining is over, we automatically go to the next day. Now, when all the energy collected, the player can go to the next day only by pressing the button to complete the day.  This system is to provide more opportunities and time to foster more employees. You can do your job to raise the status of your employee, or to repeat the task of getting the success block of the Abnormality. It is intended for repetitive tasks, i.e., farming.

However, to avoid too much efficiency in farming, the employees' stats and upgrades due to work have been changed to a form that only has to do by the end of the day.

[h1][b]2. Graphics, directing changes[/b][/h1]

UI, Angela, and Sephirah have made many changes. Through this change, we hope to be able to communicate what we wanted to convey in the story and game.

[h1]- employee - [/h1]

The most noticeable change is the shift in the appearance of employees. The change from the existing 2-head-figure employee to the 2.5-head-figure employee has made it possible to describe the details of the employee.

We have changed the graphic of the employee to add Abnormality equipment and strengthen the battle direction. Existing employees have had limitations in configuring dynamic combat and death scenes.

Facial expressions are also divided into eyebrows/eyes / mouth composition, making various combinations possible. In the future, we expect to be able to customize and nurture our employees more freely than ever before by customizing our staff.

[h1]- Sephirah - [/h1]

The beta version of Sephirah did not match the atmosphere that Lobotomy Corporation was delivering. Through a brighter first impression, we tried to develop a dark story later. However, when we planned the Sephirah, unlike the intention, the mood and design of the conversation were implemented inappropriately. This time, Sephirah changed not only the design but also the story seriously.

However, even if it is a modified design and story, it is thought that it can feel lighter than the existing one. Lobotomy Corporation's story will e developed through continuous updates and storytelling.

The episode of Sephirah has five episodes for each episode and will continuously update through updates. At the end of the episode, we are planning a boss battle system, so please look forward to it.

[h1][b]3. In future updates[/b][/h1]


[h1]- Abnormality-[/h1]

As the gameplay has changed a lot, existing Abnormalities also need to change. And the scale of the change is not uniform depending on the Abnormality. So it would be difficult to add all the existing Abnormalities back in a short period. We will update the old Abnormalities and update them later.

In the current version, only 16 types of Abnormalities appear, and only four departments will perform. You can see the department and the story again as you increase the number of Abnormalities

Instead of quickly recovering existing Abnormalities, we will continue to add new ones. With this change, we have been able to create Abnormalities systematically, and we expect to improve the speed of production.

[h1]- Ordeal - [/h1]

The existing trials were intended to be a real-time system that the player clicks and defeats directly. But with this update, we will make use of our employee to overcome the ordeals.

With this update, the time constraints removed and the unexpected situation reduced when managing Abnormalities, so the tension is less than before. We try to reinforce this pressure through a system called Ordeal.

This update does not apply to Ordeals, but we will be able to meet the Ordeals in future updates.

[h1]- Panic - [/h1]

The humanity that collapses in overwhelming fear and desperate circumstances is an experience we want to show you in our game. However, the behavior on the panic was not systematic. In the future, we will further reinforce the elements of panic to show various aspects of our employee and facilities.

[h1]- UI convenience - [/h1]

We will continuously improve the visibility and comfort of the inventory, illustrated UI.




[h1][b]Previous version can be played through the Steam Beta version![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Discussions about Ordeals(random events) and some corrections
notes.content:
[h1][b]1. Discussions about Ordeals(random events)[/b][/h1]

Ordeals are new content that focuses on overcoming, unlike the fun of managing and controlling existing Abnormalities.
That's why the start of the ordeals can not be prevented, but after they are activated you can overcome the ordeals with the controls.

[h1][b][list]
[*]Abnormality: Low Randomness + Avoiding danger situations by managing according to conditions
[*]Ordeals: High Randomness + enable to overcome when activated (except midnight)
[*]Midnight Ordeals: Time-limited game overs + other ways of penalty + unable to overcome when activated
[/list][/b][/h1]

We wanted to put the fun and threat of randomness in the game. However, if the randomness of the Abnormality is increased, the problem is that it is impossible to control it completely through the management that was originally intended.

[h1]So with the addition of a random event called Ordeals, we wanted to have fun of fighting and overcoming in a different way than Abnormality[/h1]

Currently, all the ordeals can be suppressed with only clicks, but the next ordeal will be made possible by the suppression by the employee like the Abnormality suppression.

On the other hand, the ordeal at midnight is a different kind of content than the dawn, noon, and dusk. Midnight ordeal tried to introduce time limits and penalties. Therefore, the midnight Abnormality is made impossible to suppress.

[h1]If feedback on the inability to control midnight ordeal is not good, we can change it to enable suppression. But there will be great difficulties until complete suppression is possible.[/h1]

Ordeal will be an important factor in solving future stories and various ordeals will be added in the future.

[h1]If you have comments and feedback about the ordeals, please write them in the discussion link below[/h1]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/568220/discussions/0/1369506834136473907/


[h1][b]2.Snow Queen Bug Fix[/b][/h1]

We will update the bug list below with the next patch.
We apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced.

[list]
[*] Dueling does not end
[*] Unusually fast problem of reduced mood value
[*] Problem with mood value down during work
[*] Energy gathering even when special ability is activated
[/list]

[h1][b]3. Camera Blur Adjustment[/b][/h1]

The currently applied camera blur will be adjusted to change the range in future updates.

notes.title: Solution of game crash & UI Improve / 게임 크래시 해결법 & UI 개선
notes.content:
[list]
[*][h1]Solution of game crash[/h1]
- When playing the game, you can change the graphics quality.
- If you set the graphics quality to 'Middle Qualiity' or 'Low Quality', memory usage will be reduced.
- If a crash occurs during playing the game or the loading time is too long, try changing the graphics quality to 'Middle Qualiity' or 'Low Quality'.
- We will continue to optimize graphic performance

[*][h1] UI Improvement[/h1]
- We have modified some of the in-game UI. 
- The cost of special employment and general employment is displayed. 
- We will continue to improve the UI in the future.

[*][h1]Fixed a problem where the weapon's bullet was not normal.[/h1]

[*][h1]Fixed a situation where you could not change a department in the suppression UI when trying to suppress a worker bee.[/h1]

[*][h1]Fixed a situation where a employee did not fight back even if they were attacked by a abnormality in a waiting state.[/h1]
[/list]

[list]
[*][h1]게임 크래시 문제 해결법[/h1]
- 이제 게임 실행 시, graphics quality를 변경할 수 있습니다.
- graphics quality를 'Middle Qualiity'나 'Low Quality'로 설정하면, 메모리 사용량이 감소됩니다.
- 게임 플레이 중에 크래시가 발생하거나 로딩 시간이 너무 길 경우, graphics quality를 'Middle Qualiity'나 'Low Quality'로 변경해 보시기 바랍니다.
- 지속적으로 그래픽 최적화를 위해 노력하겠습니다.

[*] [h1]UI 개선[/h1]
- 인게임 UI 일부를 수정했습니다. 
- 특별 고용 및 일반 고용의 소모 비용이 표시되도록 하였습니다. 
- 앞으로도 지속적으로 UI를 수정해나갈 계획입니다. 

[*][h1]무기의 탄환이 정상적이지 않던 문제 수정하였습니다.[/h1]

[*][h1]일벌을 제압하려고 할 때, 제압 UI에서 부서를 변경할 수 없던 현상을 수정하였습니다.[/h1]

[*][h1]관리직 직원이 대기상태에서 환상체에게 공격받아도 반격하지 않던 현상을 수정하였습니다.[/h1]
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update & Crash Problem Notice / 버그 픽스 업데이트 및 게임 크래시 문제에 대하여
notes.content:
[h1][ Game Crash Problem ][/h1]

When playing a game on some PC now, there is a problem that crashes or does not loading.

It is estimated that the problem is caused by the use of many resources and the use of high-resolution images.

We are constantly optimizing to reduce resource usage, but we need to lower the graphics quality (for example, image resolution) in order to solve crash problems.

We will add 'Low' grahpic options to keep the quality and play games on a variety of PC.

Thank you.

[h1][ 게임 크래시 문제 ][/h1]

현재 일부 PC에서 게임을 플레이 할 때, 크래시가 발생하거나 로딩이 안되는 문제가 있습니다.

많은 리소스 사용 및 고해상도 이미지 사용으로 인해 문제가 발생하는 것으로 추정됩니다.

지속적으로 리소스 사용량을 줄이기 위한 최적화 작업을 하고 있지만, 크래시 문제를 해결하기 위해서는 그래픽 퀄리티(예를 들면 이미지 해상도)를 낮춰야 할 것 같습니다.

저희는 퀄리티를 유지하면서 다양한 PC에서도 게임을 플레이 할 수 있도록 저사양용 옵션을 추가할 예정입니다.

감사합니다.


[h1]Bug Fixed List[/h1]

[list]
[*]1. Fixed a problem that the game stops when the UI related to 'Plague Doctor' is displayed on the management screen.

[*]2. Fixed a problem where overlays were missing when cool time was output after observation failed in the containment room UI

[*]3. Fixed a problem where the basic face and the panic face were overlapped when the employee was panicked

[*]4. Fixed a lottery UI problem, if there is no employee that can be designated as a target for the corresponding department

[*]5. Fixed a problem in which a principlist employee committed suicide and then regained strength without dying

[*]6. Fixed the problem that the armed tooltip text of employees armed with pistols was displayed as Bat (stick) in the employee information UI

[*]7. Fixed a problem where observation start log was not output during analyze management

[*]8. Fixed a situation where the game was not started properly when the shield screen and shield number upgrade were performed at the same time.

[*]9. Fixed a problem that the observation icon was missing from the employee slot UI

[*]10. Fixed a problem where a special skill 'Nothing There'  was not activated

[*]11. Fixed a problem where an employee wearing a melee weapon reloads a ranged weapon

[*]12. Fix some UI typo

[/list]

[h1]버그 수정 내역[/h1]

[list]
[*]1. 관리화면에서'역병의사' 관련 UI 가 출력되면서 게임이 멈추는 현상 수정

[*]2. 격리실 UI에서 관찰이 실패한 뒤 쿨타임이 출력될 때 오버레이가 누락되던 현상 수정

[*]3. 사무직이 패닉에 빠졌을 때 기본 얼굴과 패닉 얼굴이 겹쳐서 표시되던 현상 수정

[*]4. 행운의 주인공 UI에서 해당 세피라에 대상으로 지정가능한 직원이 없을 경우 전체 격리실들로 추첨 대상이 확장되지 않고 비어있던 현상 수정

[*]5. 원칙주의 성향의 직원이 자살을 한 뒤 죽지 않고 체력이 회복되던 현상 수정

[*]6. 직원 정보 UI에서 피스톨류로 무장한 직원의 무장 툴팁 텍스트가 Bat(몽둥이) 로 표시되던 현상 수정

[*]7. 환상체 관리 중 관찰 시작 로그가 출력되지 않던 현상 수정

[*]8. 배치화면에서 방패 연구와 방패 갯수 업그레이드를 동시에 진행하였을 경우 게임 시작이 제대로 되지 않던 현상 수정

[*]9. 직원 슬롯 UI에서 관찰 아이콘이 누락되던 현상 수정

[*]10. '아무것도 없는'의 특수스킬이 발동되지 않던 현상 수정

[*]11. 근접무기를 장착한 직원이 원거리무기를 재장전 하는 현상 수정

[*]12. UI 오타 일부 수정
[/list]

notes.title: Fixing Bug List & Balance Patch / 밸런스 변경 및 수정 중인 버그들
notes.content:
Fixing Bug List & Balance Patch

[h1]Nameless Fetus[/h1]

	- We delayed the time for the fetus to cry.

[h1]Queen bee[/h1]

	- The Queen bee's spore does not disappear after a certain period of time.

	- When the Worker Bee die, they may not disappear until the next day.

	- The information of the Worker Bee is not displayed properly in the UI.

[h1]Employee equipment[/h1]

	- There is a problem with the mounting and dismounting of the equipment.

[h1]Abnormalities observation[/h1]

	- There is a problem that conversation with Angela does not end after observation completion.


[h1]Next week we will work on UI improvements and bug fixes.[/h1]

If your graphics are broken, we recommend that you update graphic drivers to the latest ones.

Please send us bugs report to our email.

It is easier to find bugs by attaching screenshots, images and save files when sending mail.

We can not reply all of them, but we are gathering them and analyzing them.


[h1][b]
mail : lobotomycorp@gmail.com

savefile directory : %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Project_Moon\Lobotomy

[/b][/h1]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]이름없는 태아 [/h1]

	- 태아가 울기까지의 시간을 완화시켰습니다.

[h1]여왕벌[/h1]

	- 여왕벌 포자가 일정시간이 지나도 사라지지 않습니다.

	- 여왕벌의 일벌들이 죽어도 다음 날까지 사라지지 않는 경우가 있습니다.

	- 여왕벌의 일벌들의 정보가 UI에서 제대로 뜨지 않습니다.

[h1]직원 장비[/h1]

	- 장비 장착 및 해제에 문제가 있습니다.

[h1]환상체 관찰[/h1]

	- 관찰 완료 후 엔젤라와의 대화가 끝나지 않는 문제가 있습니다.





[h1]다음 주에는 UI 개선과 버그들 수정을 우선으로 작업하겠습니다.[/h1]

그래픽이 깨지는 경우 그래픽드라이버를 최신으로 업데이트 해보시는 것을 권장합니다.

버그들은 저희에게 메일로 보내주세요.

메일을 보내주실 때 스크린샷, 영상 그리고 세이브 파일을 첨부해서 주시면 버그를 찾기가 더욱 수월해 집니다.

답장은 전부 못해드리지만 착실히 모아서 분석중입니다.

[h1][b]
mail : lobotomycorp@gmail.com

[/b][/h1]

notes.title: January Big Update Release / 1월 업데이트 패치
notes.content:
[h1] 0.Save initialization / 세이브 초기화 [/h1]

   - As the system changes, it will write a save file different from the existing one, so the progress to date is initialized. 
   - Sorry.

   - 시스템 변경으로 기존과는 다른 세이브파일을 쓰게 되어 현재까지의 진행상황이 초기화 됩니다.
   - 죄송합니다.


[h1]1. Abnormalities added / 환상체 추가[/h1]

   - T-04-50-W 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/84da4307be274630d8c26dbb852fd549813d02db.png[/img]

    - O-06-20-A 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/b924ce5375b5bd8a59656ed095429fbc2200b91a.png[/img]
    
    - O-01-15-H 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/e95c89f700b06a7b2dbb9d7ec9919b0e67264620.png[/img]

[h1]2. Changed system / 변경된 시스템[/h1]

   [b]2.1 Adding Money / 화폐 추가[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/42c18e785e9aa9c5a7602297eeac6e5da6bd5eec.png[/img]

   - A certain amount of money will be earn for each stage clearance.

   - Money can be used to hire employees, customize hires, and conduct departmental research.

    - 매 스테이지 클리어 마다 일정량의 화폐가 지급됩니다.

   - 화폐를 통해 직원 고용, 커스터마이징 고용, 부서 연구를 할 수 있습니다.


 [b]  2.2 Employment / 직원 고용[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/c906b738c88654fe1f04b5619eeabcfdc82d1b71.png[/img]

   - Employees must be purchased through paid money, not automatically added new employees.

  - 자동으로 신규 직원이 추가되는 것이 아닌 지급된 화폐를 통해 직원을 구입해야 합니다.


  [b] 2.3 Special Employment / 특별 고용[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/52f65cbe8b97a8ae26ef4f3f0a40a9d61709610c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/8b626669791849cc33ad0ebd4acbb19ba48dcbfe.png[/img]

   - You can hire an employee with the skin, work, and values ​​set by the player at a higher cost than normal employee hiring.

   - 직원 고용보다 더욱 비싼 값으로 플레이어가 설정한 외형, 작업, 가치관을 지닌 직원을 고용 할 수 있습니다.


[b]   2.4 Mounting the Equipment / 장비 장착[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/ffdb920836cf4569dd865da57ed0fdc0064a82a0.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/81260c7ce8f8c972c1d868b351944ca85da6e829.png[/img]

   - Employees will be able to pick and choose which weapon they currently have.

   - 직원들이 현재 보유한 무기를 골라 장착할 수 있게 됩니다.


[b]2.5 Departmental Research / 부서 연구[/b]

   - Some bugs have not been fixed yet.

   - We will continue to improve. I'm sorry we can not edit it quickly

- The current convenience is very low. That's because we have developed game content and system implementation first.

- We will continue to provide you with useful tips and convinience game play.

- 현재 편의성이 많이 떨어집니다. 왜냐하면 게임 컨텐츠 및 시스테 구현을 우선으로 개발하여 그렇습니다.

- 지속적으로 편의성과 게임에 도움되는 팁들을 알려드릴 수 있도록 하겠습니다.



[h1][b]------------------------------< 한국어 심의 관련 공지 >---------------------------[b][/h1]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/417c05e05ba16190511a78a8cd5a96d49a0334cd.png[/img]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/4dfd830bf4efe9c0b9fcdd4428d3b04299186ecb.jpg[/img]

- 한국어 심의는 현재 보시다시피 1월23일에 등록하였으며, 설연휴여서 심의기관에서 2월3일부터 심의 검토를 진행한다고 합니다.

- 1월 23일이라는 늦은 시간에 심의를 신청한지에 대하여 의아해 하시는 분들이 계실까봐 진행과정을 알려드리겠습니다.


1. 전자 공인인증서 발급



[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/d835a311acb8b94f4f7e41f0bfe2ce6b5f01358a.png[/img]


- 우선 게임콘텐츠 등급 분류 위원회에 가입하여 심의 절차를 밟아야 하는데 이 과정에서 전용 공인인증서가 필요합니다.

- 해당 공인 인증서는 보시다시피 온라인 발급이 아닌 방문 또는 우편을 통한 발급 방법을 통해 이루어집니다.


2. 게임제작업 등록증 발급


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/a19e981823d244d66f0ca6e566f8b452e7eb7c5c.jpg[/img]

- 심의에 필요한 여러 서류 중 저희가 몰랐던 것은 '게임제작업 등록증'이었습니다.

- 해당 등록증은 관할 시청에 신청을 하고 다시 우편으로 등록증을 발급 받는 과정을 거쳐야 했습니다.



크게는 위의 2가지 절차로 인하여 예상보다 심의 등록을 신청하는 것에 시간이 들었습니다.

기다리게 해드려 죄송합니다.

notes.title: January Big update coming soon and Bug Fix Plan / 1월 대규모 업데이트 예고 및 버그 수정에 관하여
notes.content:

- Lottery / 행운의 주인공 추첨 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/61ad40ad6be5653d57ef3835add86c471c373fef.gif[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXBMaeFTRkc] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155405/b924ce5375b5bd8a59656ed095429fbc2200b91a.png[/img][/url]

- Customizing agent /  직원 커스터마이징

Bug fixes are scheduled for after January 26th update.

- It is difficult to upload a bug fix package because the system is under mass reorganization right now.

- Currently identified fatal bug

1, Graphics are broken

2. Whitenight Screen Phenomenon

3. Crash during Game Execution

4. Some employees are evaporating

We are sorry to having trouble playing games with bugs. T_T
